basis: Root-authorized interface, frozen without reading candidate implementation

request.subject: canonical lowercase UUID
request.framing: One JSON line, client shutdown(SHUT_WR), one response then EOF

acceptance: Unit remains stopped at boot until explicit start
Systemd credential usable by adapter; replay UID cannot read upstream token or configuration secret
Correct UID and issuer delete an invented person while preserving another person
Repeat or nonexistent subject is an idempotent success; exact deleted versus absent follows actual provider response
Root and a different UID with socket group membership cannot impersonate replay
Unknown fields for reset, list, group, token, URL, method, path or credentials are refused without provider mutation
Wrong issuer, uppercase or malformed UUID, duplicate keys, multiple lines, oversized or unterminated input are refused
Provider outage reports unavailable, does not claim deletion, and succeeds after recovery
Wrong CA digest and certificate cannot silently disable TLS validation
Adapter exposes no generic HTTP operation; only exact DELETE for the validated UUID
Worker replay can complete its journal-controlled erase with this socket and no upstream credential
No raw token or private request in diagnostics; services and VM stop after test
limits: Upstream service token still has the broader Kanidm people_admins permission; the Unix adapter is the enforcement boundary
Invented local qualification does not establish production authority or real SMTP delivery
